name: Anime Monster Collector
desc:
🌸 ANIMOCO - The Official Crunchyroll AniMo-collecting adventure on Roblox! 🌸

Hunt, collect, and power up 70+ AniMo across Forest, Desert, City and Volcano expeditions — then build the rarest collection.

How to Play:
🗺️ Explore Forest, Desert, City & Volcano Expeditions
⭐ Discover & collect 70+ unique AniMo - can you find the rarest?
🚀 Find and upgrade AniMo
💰 Earn Coins and level up your skills
🔥 Show off your best AniMo team

🎁 Crunchyroll Members get exclusive in-game rewards — start a Free Trial here and claim yours!
👥 Better with friends — team up and explore together.
🔔 New AniMo and updates added regularly.

👍 Like + Favorite + Join Our Community so you never miss a drop!
